footer_mac: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. Every shortcut includes {mod}, so single keys are never taken over. Press {help} any time to see your shortcuts.
footer_other: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. Every shortcut includes {mod}, so single keys are never taken over. On Windows and Linux, Ctrl shortcuts override the same keys in the terminal (like Ctrl+K); you can change them here. Press {help} any time to see your shortcuts.
recording_label: {name}: press the new shortcut, Esc to cancel
terminal_footer: The terminal handles these keys itself. They can't be changed, and no other shortcut takes them.
